notes.title: Spring is here! (v.2.3.0)
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43278239/47c7d568f5ab89718dbca2f57f3fa4a92c926a2d.png[/img]
Hey everyone! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2372850/Baker_Business_3__Spring_Pack/]The Baker Business 3 Spring Pack is [i]finally[/i] here[/url]!

To everyone who's been asking about the Spring Pack and waiting for its release, thank you for your patience! The Spring Pack was intended to be released sooner but things got hectic and development time was delayed. We appreciate your enthusiasm and hope you enjoy the pack!

The Spring Pack has a fun mix of florals, pastels, and all things spring with a good variety of Easter-themed items too. We wanted the pack to be centered around Spring in general with plenty of pops of Easter without it feeling holiday-specific.

[h2]Features:[/h2]

[h3]Festive Recipes:[/h3] We’ve added over 40 new Spring and Easter-themed recipes. Picture lots of flowers, bunnies, bumble bees, Easter eggs, and spring chicks all in the form of cakes, cookies, donuts, and more!

[h3]Hunt for Eggs:[/h3] Find decorated eggs hiding in random places inside and outside of your bakery. Collect them to earn extra Spring Tokens!

[h3]Decorate your Bakery:[/h3] Get your bakery fresh and ready for Spring with a fun mix of decorations! String up pretty bunting, hang butterfly banners, [i]egg-cellent[/i] chalkboard designs, paper cutouts of flowers, bows, and more.

[h3]Visit the Spring Shop:[/h3] Earn Spring Tokens from baking and selling the Spring baked goods you unlock. Spend your tokens in the Spring shop to buy lovely decorations, potted flowers, wallpapers, and more!

[h3]Easter Baskets:[/h3] Pick your favorite basket and fill it to the brim with cute candies to pass out to your customers.

[h3]Seasonal Wallpapers:[/h3] We've added 9 seasonal wallpapers including different flower wallpapers, Easter egg wallpapers, and fresh spring grid wallpapers.

With this update, we've also included various bug fixes.

We hope you enjoy the Spring Pack as much as we do!
